exposure: clinical symptoms of fibroids (as reported by women)
outcome: level of knowledge regarding uterine fibroids
attitudes towards uterine fibroid management (e.g., surgery)
perceptions regarding the causes and treatments of uterine fibroids
understanding of fibroids' impact on childbearing
cohort: The participants were women of reproductive age attending the outpatient department of Obstetrics and Gynecology.
finding: The study found that most women in the reproductive age group had poor knowledge regarding uterine fibroids and held various misconceptions about their etiology, management, and impact on fertility.
